purpose: Test an actual query intervention suggested by September/October source-context confounders instead of claiming review annotations improve retrieval.

candidate_mutation.rationale: Problem/pain queries may reduce supplier-driven content while retaining more authentic unmet-need discussion threads.

scientific_limits: The April 2026 data are untouched by recorded May-October PR225-238 runs, but one historical window and one source cannot independently validate a generalized effect.
Candidate query_mode=pain is an already-known bounded genome setting, not an automatically self-taught improvement.
Review-only source_context flag changes inspection order only, never scoring or accepted threads.
Queries differ by suffixes across arms; matching is on topic, source, time, count and classifier, not identical-result pairing.
A positive machine-signal verdict would remain unvalidated: human review and independent-source replications required.
No raw HN texts, URLs, IDs or query strings can enter artifacts, logs, PR comments or production.
